caseNameFull: Doubleday & Co., Inc. v. New York
attorneys: Whitney North Seymour argued the cause for appellant., With him on the brief was George G. Gallantz. Whitman Knapp argued the cause for appellee., With him on the brief was Frank S. Hogan. Kenneth W. Greenawalt filed a brief for the American Civil Liberties Union, as amicus curiae, urging reversal.

opinions.text:
Per Cu-riam:

The judgment is affirmed by an equally divided Court.

Mr. Justice Frankfurter took no part in the consideration or decision of this case.
